contexts.text: See Deep.
These Knowledges are here called the faces of the waters.
Inmost things are signified by the face.
Two faces were as it were induced on me... When the Angels perceive that their faces are received, they know that the man is dead. SE 1097.
The face of Jehovah () = mercy, peace, and all good. Illustrated. AC 358:end. AC 387. AC 3195:end.
His faces fell () = that the interiors were changed. AC 358. AC 359.
With the ancients, the face = internal things, because internal things shine forth through the face. In ancient times their faces agreed exactly with their internals...
When charity shone from the face, they said that the face was elevated; but when the contrary, they said that the face fell.
Under Ground, see this reference. AC 566.
To be hidden from Thy faces () = to be separated from all the good of the faith of love. AC 398.
Their faces appeared sharp, beautiful enough.
They spoke... by innumerable changes of the expression and face... AC 1118:2. AC 4799. AC 7361:2. AC 8249. AC 10709:end.
The intellectual things of Spirits and Angels flow into the left part or the face, and the voluntary things into the right.
The deceitful appear to have a broad face, four or five times as broad as the faces of others. SE 2498.
Their faces are worse than that of a dead man.
Their faces were black. SE 3486. SE 3745.
They sometimes appear to themselves to have a shining face. AC 2027:2. AC 8739.
Their faces are like a round cake, broad.
Faces of flames () = cupidities.
Spirits who belong to a certain internal province of the face.
The charity which shines from the face is not of the face...
Spirits who... expressed their meaning by changes induced on my face...
The Angel of His faces () = the Lord's mercy towards universal mankind.
The face = the interiors. AC 1999. AC 2327. AC 2434. AC 3527:2. AC 4066. AC 4835:4. AC 4859:end. AC 4866. AC 5695, Explained. AC 8925.
To fall upon the face. Explained. AC 2071.

They looked to the faces of Sodom () = the state of mankind... Faces = all the interiors of man, both evil and good; because these shine forth from the face. Here, therefore, faces, being predicated of Sodom, = evil interiors which are of the love of self.
When Angels are presented to view, their interiors shine forth from the face.
Men who in the life of the body have been merely natural, when presented to view in the other life according to that state, appear hairy over nearly the whole face. AC 5247. AC 5571:end. AC 5573:end.
For it is the animus which appears in the face. Explained. AC 3573:3. AC 4215, Explained.
The face with the Angels and with the most ancients. Described. AC 4326. AC 5695. AC 8370:2. AC 10177:4. HH 414:2.
To go out from the faces () = when these things ceased; thus when the state was changed.
The Societies which constitute the province of the face... AC 4800.
They were allowed to effigy a face in various ways by influx.
From the affections of the animus, which present themselves to view in the face...
In human faces, in which for the most part the affections effigy themselves, no two are exactly alike. AC 6232:3. AC 7236:2.
Under Eagle, see this reference.
That the face is the image of the animus...
Under Affection, see this reference. AC 4407:2. AC 4796. AC 4797. AC 5102. AC 7360.
A face appeared to me.
Under Peniel, see this reference.
Under Deliver, see this reference.
Faces = the interiors, thus the thoughts and affections.
Under Cerebellum, see this reference. AC 4326:3. SE 3868.
At this day there is scarcely any general involuntary sense left in the face. AC 4327.
To see his faces as the faces of God () = affection with perception; for the faces = the interiors; and the faces of God, all good, which, when it flows in, gives affection with perception.
To the faces of the city () = to the goods of that truth; for the faces = the interiors, thus the affections of good and truth which shine forth from the face.
The Spirits who are at the face are of diverse genius, according to correspondence with the sensories there...
The faces of evil Spirits. AC 4798, Described. AC 5695, Explained. AC 9794. HH 553:2. SE 5669:2.
On the correspondence of the face with the Grand Man.
The Lord lift up His faces = that from the Divine affection of love He has mercy.
Under Cupidity, see this reference.
The faces of the men of another world described.
Whatever a man wants to hide, contracts his face... AC 8247:2. AC 8250.
To cover the faces () = that truth is not seen at all.

The Angels do not see the faces of men in their material, but in their spiritual form; that is, in the form presented by the affections and consequent thoughts; these also are what cause the real face with man...
The Natural is as a face...

Without such an interior face, or such a plane, a man in the body cannot think at all about the things which are above sensuous things; for he sees them there as when a man sees the affections and thoughts in another's face, not attending to the face itself.
The faces of Spirits and Angels are formed from and according to the exterior Natural. Described.
They lie there face down wards.
The quality of Spirits and Angels... in the Rational, appears from the face and its beauty. AC 5319.
He had no face, but something blackly bearded instead of a face. AC 5566:end.
These for a face had a direful grate of teeth. AC 5565. AC 5567:end. AC 10429. SE 3507.
To be devoid of a face = that there is nothing of rational life; for when no face appears, it is a sign that there is no correspondence of the interiors with the Grand Man.
The face represents the interiors of man, thus his spiritual and celestial things, that is, the things which are of faith and charity.
Ye shall not see my faces () = no pity. AC 5816.
That the face of Jehovah = the Divine love, is evident from the Lord's face when He was transfigured, (which) shone as the sun.
To make the faces shine () = to have mercy; and to lift up the faces = to give peace. Illustrated.
To see the faces of God () = to enjoy peace and good from mercy.
To hide his faces () = not to have mercy.
He lifted up portions from his faces for them () = goods applied to everyone from mercy.
They have a ferine face.
After I have seen thy faces () = after the apperception of mercy.
I did not think to see thy faces () = that he had not been in hope concerning the influx of his love.
Joseph fell upon the faces of his father (. 1) = the influx of the Internal into the affection of good. To fall upon the faces of anyone = influx... And the face = affection.
Moses covered his faces () = that the interiors were protected.
The face (of the woman of Mercury) was beautiful, but smaller than the faces of the women of our Earth.
Good forms the faces of the Angels.
The Spirits of Mars are represented with the face in Heaven, and the body in the World of Spirits...
With them the face acts as one with the thought, so that the affection itself of the thought shines forth from the face.
(The faces of the inhabitants of Mars are like the faces of the inhabitants of our Earth, but the lower part of the face is black, not from a beard...)
In the opposite sense, the face of Jehovah = no mercy, no peace, and no good. Explained. AC 9306:4, Illustrated. AR 939:3.
The face of man's spirit is entirely according to that which reigns universally with him.

Evil is with your faces () = that in the desire there is no good. The faces = the interiors as to the affections and the consequent thoughts (References); and as the faces = the affections, they also = the desires.
He drove them out from the faces of Pharaoh () = that the will of those who infested was utterly opposed to truth Divine... The faces = the interiors as to the affections, thus the will.
To see his faces no more () = no more to enter into the animus. The face = the interiors, especially as to the affections; thus the face = the animus. AC 7738.
The Angels of Jupiter came to me... They had an influx into the face, so that the face concurred with every particular... AC 8113.
The faces of the inhabitants of Jupiter are like the faces of the men of oar Earth, white, but more beautiful; sincerity and modesty shine out from them.

When the Spirits of Jupiter were with me, the faces of the inhabitants of our Earth used to appear less; because the idea flowed in which those Spirits had about their own faces, that they were larger; for when they live as men they believe that after death their faces will be larger, and round in form; and therefore... when they become Spirits, they seem to themselves to have a larger face. The reason they believe that their faces will be larger, is that they say the face is not the body, because they speak and present their thoughts through it; and because the mind is thus as it were seen through it; hence they have an idea of the face as being the mind in form; and as they know that they will be wiser after their life in the world, they believe that the form of the mind, that is, the face, will be larger. AC 8379.
They also believe that after death they will perceive a fire which will warm their faces. Explained.
On this account they frequently wash and cleanse their faces; and also carefully preserve them from the heat of the sun... AC 8379:end.

They said that the faces of the men of our Earth are not beautiful; and wondered that the faces of some are full of warts and pimples, and are in other respects disfigured; and said that none such appear among them.

In their Earth the faces of almost all are smiling and cheerful; because they have no solicitude about future things, and have no care for worldly things... The reason their faces are prominent about the lips, is that the most of their speech is effected by the face... and also because they never dissemble... therefore they do not force their faces. AC 8248.
The face was formed wholly to effigy the things which man thinks and wills; hence the face is called the effigy and index of the animus.
(The inhabitants of Jupiter) are very willing that their faces should be seen, because hence their mind appears...
Under Bed, see this reference.
His face as the aspect of lightning () = the love of truth...

Thou shalt not have other gods before My faces () = that truths are not to be thought about from any other source than the Lord... Faces, when predicated of God, = love, mercy, peace, good; thus the Lord Himself...
The face = the affections. References.
The face in the Word, = the interiors, especially the affections. References.
The face of God, in the Word, = good itself. References.
(The Spirits of the moon) appeared of a face not unhandsome, but longer than the faces of all other Spirits.

Faces, when predicated of Jehovah, = the Divine good of the Divine love, or mercy. And as the Divine good of the Divine love is Jehovah Himself or the Lord, to be seen at the faces of the Lord Jehovah () has a like signification to being seen by the Lord.

Take heed of his face () = holy fear... It is said take heed of his face, because by the face are signified the interiors which are of the life, thus which are of the thought and affection, and especially which are of the faith and love. The reason is that the face is formed to the image of the interiors of man, to the end that those things which are of the internal man may appear in the external, thus that the things which are of the Spiritual world may appear before the sight in the natural world... And therefore, in the Original Language, face is a general term which is applied to describe the affections... Hence it is, that in that language, with adjunctives, it means nigh to, with, before, on account of, and also what is contrary; thus whatever is in himself, from himself, for himself, and against himself; for the face is the man himself, or that which is in him and appears.
Hence it may be known (that) the face of Jehovah = the Divine good of the Divine love, and the Divine truth from this Divine good; for these are in Him, and are Himself. Illustrated.
Hence it is that the Lord as to the Divine Human is called the Angel of the faces of Jehovah (). Explained.
Their faces, of a man to his brother () = the conjunction of truth and good. The face = the interiors; here, mental view and conjunction.
To the mercy-seat shall be the faces of the cherubs () = the interiors constantly looking to good, thus to the Lord.

They who are elevated by the Lord (and the Angels) continually turn their faces to the Lord, because the Lord keeps them conjoined with Himself through the good of love; but they who are not elevated turn their faces from the Lord. AC 9828:2. AC 9864:2. AC 10420:3.

The bread of faces () = the Lord as to celestial good... Faces, when predicated of the Lord, = everything which is from the Divine love; as innocence, peace, joy; thus Heaven itself with man and Angel. AC 9546. AC 9571.
To My faces continually () = thus the Lord's presence with peace and with heavenly joy from mercy.

Faces, when predicated of man and Angel, = the interiors which are of the will and of the understanding thence, thus which are of love and of faith thence. References. AC 9936, Explained. (as to the various parts of the face). AE 427.
The Angel of faces = the Lord as to Divine good; for the face of Jehovah = love, mercy, good. AC 9936. AC 10433.
Over against its faces () = to eternity. Explained. AC 9935.
The light of faces () = the Divine truth from the Divine good.
See Earth. AC 10315. AC 10754.
To turn the face to anyone, in the internal sense, = to love.
To speak faces to faces () = to be conjoined; for the faces = the interiors, and when the interiors mutually regard each other, and see what is like, they conjoin themselves.
One thing is signified by to speak faces to faces, and another by to see Jehovah face to face.
My faces shall go () = that what is Divine of the Church, of worship, and of the Word will be there. AC 10568.
The faces of the ground = wherever the Church is. AC 10570:end.
To pass by upon his faces () = upon the external separated from what is internal in which was Moses and the nation he was over...
Thou canst not see My faces () = that the Divine interiors of the Church, of worship, and of the Word cannot appear to the Israelitish nation. AC 10584.
For the Lord is the face itself of Jehovah. Explained.
Illustrated.
Jehovah passed upon his faces () = Divine internal things upon external ones.
See Drive out.
The sparkling of the skin of Moses' face () = the internal of the Word giving forth light in its external. AC 6752:9. AC 10705.
From their faces (in the Sixth Earth) they see whether they agree in minds.
All who form one angelic Society have a face that is like in general, but is not like in particular. Explained.

In Heaven all the interior affections appear and shine forth from the face; for the face there is their external and representative form; to have another face than that of one's own affections does not exist in Heaven. HH 48.

A face as of an Angel appeared to me, which was varied according to the affections of good and truth, such as exist with those who are in one Society. The variations lasted a long time; and I observed that the same face in general remained as a plane, and that the rest were only derivations and propagations thereof... SE 2094. SE 2203.
Under Correspond, see this reference.
The interiors make the face of an Angel and a Spirit; and in the Spiritual World... it is the face which determines (the quarters). HH 131. HH 143.
If anyone dissents, he must turn away his face.

As heavenly loves open the interiors to the Lord, all the Angels turn their faces to the Lord; for in the Spiritual World it is the love which turns the interiors of everyone to itself, and wherever it turns the interiors it also turns the face; for the face there acts as one with the interiors, it being their external form. HH 479:2. DLW 105:end. DLW 129, General article. DP 326:5.
Especially when they look at each other face to face...

When the spirit first enters the World of Spirits... he has a like face... But afterwards the face is changed, and becomes... like his ruling love... For the face of the spirit differs very much from the face of the body; the face of the body is from the parents; but the face of the spirit from the affection... I have seen some who were recently from the world, and knew them from their face and speech; but when they were seen afterwards, I did not know them. They who had been in good affections were seen with a beautiful face; but they who had been in evil affections, with a deformed face; for, regarded in itself, the spirit of man is nothing but its own affection, the external form of which is the face. The reason the faces are changed, is that in the other life it is not allowable for anyone to counterfeit affections which are not properly his own, thus neither to induce on himself faces contrary to the love in which he is... Hence it is that the faces of all are the forms and effigies of their affections... HH 493. DP 224:end. CL 273:end.
The faces of hypocrites are changed later than the faces of the rest...
Therefore the more interior the affection is... the more beautiful is the face.

So far as anyone acts and speaks according to another's love, the latter appears... with a full, cheerful, living face; but so far as anyone acts and speaks contrary to his love, his face begins to be changed, to be obscured, and not to appear. HH 553. DLW 369. AE 837.
Hence the face of one can never be exactly like that of another; for the face is the image of the animus; and in the Spiritual World it is the image of the reigning love. DLW 318:end.

They who have not acted clandestinely, but have wanted all things they thought to appear openly... in Heaven have faces which shine; and in the face, from that light, each of their affections and thoughts appears as in form... While they are speaking, the face is a little obscured, but when they have done speaking, the same things which they spoke appeal simultaneously in the face in full view.
Communication with others there takes place according to the conversion of the face...
His face which flashed as the sun = His Divine good.
Like a man whose face and hands are bare.
The Lord sees and looks at everyone face to face...
The interiors of the face are the brains.
These two worlds are entirely similar in external appearance... But as to their internal complexion they are entirely dissimilar.
He then turns his face from the devil to the Lord; and when he turns his face to the Lord, love and wisdom are given him. These enter man by the face...
Such appear there like faces without a head...
Not allowed to see the Divine Providence on the face.
Within the outward appearance... DP 298:4.

His face as the sun shining in his power () = the Divine love and the Divine wisdom, which are Himself... The face of Jehovah or of the Lord = the Divine itself in its essence, which is the Divine love and the Divine wisdom, thus Himself. AR 467. AE 64:2. AE 74.
They who constitute the face, with all its organs of sense (are meant by the tribes of Israel in ).
Their faces were as the faces of men () = that they appeared to themselves as wise... Man's face = wisdom and intelligence. ( = the affections of truth. AE 554.)
The face (of the serpent) = cunning.
The face, in the Word, = that which is with man interiorly, because the face is the type of his animus formed to correspondence; hence the face of the serpent = anger, hatred, and cunning.
The Angels were impelled to fall on their faces.

They shall see His face () = that they will turn themselves to the Lord... To see the face of... the Lord does not mean to see His face; because no one can see His face, as He is in His Divine love and Wisdom, and live... for to see His face, as He is in Himself, would be as if one should enter into the sun... But the Lord sometimes presents Himself to be seen out of His Sun. Explained... But by their seeing His face is not here meant to see His face in this manner, but to see the truths which are in the Word from Him; and through them to Know and acknowledge Him. Explained.
Illustrated. TCR 135:4.
They seemed... as if their faces were unconnected with their bodies.
(Origin of the harder face of the male.) CL 218.

That no two men have exactly the same love, may appear from the infinite variety of human faces; faces being types of loves; for that faces are changed and varied according to the affections of love is known...
(The faces of a husband and a wife from the Third Heaven. Described.)
Can the love of the sex stop at the face of a woman?
I observed as it were the unity of their souls in their faces.
They had faces as of steel...
He no longer endures to look his consort directly in the face.
They had round faces, which glistened like the scales of a shell.
(The doorkeeper said), I was told that I should know (whom to admit) by their faces... All the Angels can see from the faces of others the delights of their hearts...
At a distance they seem to have white faces consisting only of skin...
They appeared to me... to have faces of chalk. SE 1248.
There are two faces to this faith...
As a face before the work...
In Jupiter etc. they speak by the face. SE 529. SE 530. SE 574. SE 3864:end. SE 3885.
(The faces of men in Jupiter. Described.) SE 547. SE 583.
That such bristly, misty, fiery, and also such beautiful faces... originate from the inspection of the Angels.
The general natural influx projects itself especially into the face, and into the region of the loins. The other parts depend more upon the will... but not ho the face...

The general natural sense first occupied the whole face, afterwards the left side of the face, and at last only the ear... The changes of the affections, or of celestial things, are of the right side of the face, (and) those of spiritual things, are of the left side of the face... It is not allowable to proceed from... spiritual to celestial things, and therefore the right side of the face is guarded by the Lord, to prevent the influx from the left side extending itself thither...
How, at this day, the case is with influx into faces, which influxes are not natural... See SE 3866.
On the face of an ape.
Spirits who think about future things... appear with a broad face; but it is not a face, but only the broad area of a face...
Hypocrites have no face. Described. See SE 5903.
That the faces of men are altered there. SE 4730. Described.
Then, good conjoined with truth forms the face.
That all are Known who are alike, whatever face they may have... The reason is that the whole thought of one is communicated to another, and the affection of the thought makes the face.
He could induce on himself various different faces...
(Good Spirits are instructed by changes in their faces, if they have not thought well.)
(They who are in good but not in truths) appear to have faces covered with monstrous prominences Hence it was evident, that the Intellectual conjoined with the Voluntary appears in the face.
They who appear in the world with faces good and gentle... but inwardly think evil about all...
The face of a man () = the affection of truth. AE 282:9.

The Divine love from which the Lord flows in, is meant by the faces of Jehovah (); the Divine truth with which the Lord flows in, is meant by Jehovah make His faces to shine upon thee; and the Divine good with which He flows in, is meant by Jehovah lift up His faces upon thee. AE 365:12. AE 412:4.
The faces = affection. AE 406:2. AE 504:2. AE 688:2. AE 721:22.
Faces = love and faith.
The face, when predicated of the Lord, = the Divine love from which is the Divine good in Heaven. Illustrated. AE 594:2. AE 596. AE 1070:3.
The face of the Lord, in the proper sense, is the Sun of the angelic Heaven...
Therefore, also, the face of Jehovah = the interior things of the Church, of the Word, and of worship. Illustrated.
But the face, when predicated of man, = the animus and his affection, thus the interiors which belong to his mind. Explained, Illustrated.
References to passages on the subject of the face.
The faces of Jehovah = the good of love.
To fall upon the faces = humiliation of heart, because it corresponds to this humiliation. AE 688, Explained.
The faces of Jehovah = the things which are revealed in the Word.
His faces = the Divine love, and enlightenment thence.
Face to face = to the life, and to the acknowledgement.
To cover the face that he see not the earth () = that the truths of good are no longer seen in the Church. AE 1145:8.
As the Angels turn their faces to their consorts, they are, in the same proportion, in a state of wisdom...
The faces of the Angels are types of their minds.
The face of a Spirit is changed according to the changes of his affections. LJPost 5M 1.
